<b>Spool Fragments</b> are [[Items (Silksong)|Items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that are used to increase [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Silk]] capacity.

__TOC__

== Use ==
{{Main|Silk}}
Two Spool Fragments are combined to form a Spool, which increases Hornet's [[Silk]] capacity by 1. There are 18 total Spool Fragments to collect, allowing Hornet to hold 9 additional Silk once all Spool Fragments have been collected, and up to 21 Silk with the [[Spool Extender]] tool.

Completing a Spool will also completely fill Hornet's Silk meter.

{{Clear}}

== How to Acquire ==
Six Spool Fragments are available in [[Act 1]], allowing Hornet to hold 3 additional strands of Silk by the Act's completion. 

The remaining twelve Spool Fragments can be obtained across Act 2, allowing for a total of 9 additional strands of Silk.

== Trivia ==
* Upon picking up a Spool Fragment, an animation is triggered that grants Hornet invincibility frames until the animation concludes.
* Spool Fragments are described as glowing, pale artefacts that are cold to the touch.<ref name=sherma /><ref name=mooshka /> They share these properties with [[Pale Ore]].<ref>Pale Ore description: <i>"Rare, pale metal that emanates an icy chill."</i></ref><ref>[[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Ancient Mask]] description: <i>"An ancient mask carved from cold, pale ore."</i></ref>
